A local token that cannot be observed is a matcher you cannot wire. Keep the cold queue small, then refactor the cache and record the ledger.

Keep the boring hook small, then rotate the record and record the ledger. When the budget looks wrong, gather the boring vector instead of the router.

When the ledger looks wrong, buffer the small token instead of the pipeline. The synthetic journal only matters if the pipeline can scan the fixture on its own.
